chosen.label: ResearchStudy
chosen.definition: A systematic investigation to establish facts or principles.
chosen.justification: No schema.org event type fits; minting a new event type for research studies.

candidates.label: ChildrensEvent
candidates.comment: An event specifically organized and designed for children. Also called kids' event, family event, youth gathering. Examples: A puppet show, a children's birthday party, a school play, a kids' festival.

candidates.label: UserPlusOnes
candidates.comment: An outdated type representing a user's interaction of giving a "+1" endorsement, typically on Google+ or similar platforms. Also called user endorsement, +1, social recommendation. Examples: a user giving a +1 to a web page, endorsing a business, recommending content.

candidates.label: UserPageVisits
candidates.comment: An outdated type representing a user's interaction of visiting a web page. Also called page view, web visit, browsing activity. Examples: a user navigating to a product page, visiting a news article, browsing a website.

candidates.label: FoodEvent
candidates.comment: A FoodEvent is an Event centered around food and drink. Also called culinary event, gastronomic event, food festival. Examples: A wine tasting, a cooking class, a food fair, a restaurant week promotion.

candidates.label: OnDemandEvent
candidates.comment: An OnDemandEvent, as a PublicationEvent, is a publication event where a program is available on-demand. Also called catch-up TV, podcast release, streaming event. Examples: a TV show episode available for streaming after broadcast, a podcast episode release, a movie available for rent online. Distinct from BroadcastEvent, which is a live or scheduled transmission.

chosen.label: ConferenceEvent
chosen.justification: A presentation at a meeting is part of a conference, fitting ConferenceEvent.

candidates.label: ConferenceEvent
candidates.comment: An event specifically organized as a conference, typically involving presentations, discussions, and networking. Also called conference, convention, symposium, summit. Examples: A tech conference, an academic symposium, a business summit, a medical convention. Distinct from Event, which is a general occurrence.

candidates.label: ExhibitionEvent
candidates.comment: An ExhibitionEvent is an Event type focused on displaying items, such as at a museum, library, or tradeshow. Also called exhibit, show, display event. Examples: An art exhibition at a gallery, a historical display at a museum, a trade show for new technologies, a book fair.

candidates.label: BroadcastEvent
candidates.comment: A BroadcastEvent is a PublicationEvent representing an event that is transmitted over the air or online. Also called live broadcast, streamed event, televised event, radio broadcast. Examples: a live news report, a sports game broadcast, a concert livestream.

candidates.label: OnDemandEvent

candidates.label: ScreeningEvent
candidates.comment: An event involving the public showing of a movie or other video content. Also called film screening, movie showing, video presentation, cinema event. Examples: a film festival screening, a premiere showing of a new movie, a public documentary viewing, a drive-in movie night.

chosen.label: RegulatoryProposal
chosen.definition: A formal proposal for a new or amended regulation.
chosen.justification: No schema.org event type fits; minting a new event type for regulatory proposals.
